docuLanguageListResources.title: New Eurobarometer survey shows young people's growing engagement and views on participatory democracy, youth issues, and EU's added value in their lives
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: Today, the European Commission published a Eurobarometer survey showing young Europeans' growing engagement with and views on democracy.

docuLanguageListResources.title: Joint statement by High Representative/Vice-President Kallas and Commissioner Kos on the early parliamentary elections in Serbia
docuLanguageListResources.leadText: On Sunday 25 October, the people of Serbia turned out in historic numbers to make their voices heard. Voters have given the next government a strong mandate for change. We look forward to seeing this being realised in practice.
